scope: Complete mapping of the pinned standard shadcn catalog; this file is a port plan, not pixel-perfect implementation evidence.

fidelityContract.acceptance: Zero differing decoded RGBA pixels against two repeatable independent vanilla-renderer launches per declared case; preserve standard shadcn APIs and accessible web behavior.
fidelityContract.composition: Native constituents may be pixel-verified; a newly designed composition cannot be called a pixel-perfect port of a nonexistent vanilla widget.
fidelityContract.nonvisual: Layout and behavior providers have no independent pixels. Verify child appearance and provider behavior.
fidelityContract.nativeSelect: The operating-system native popup cannot be fully skinned by registry CSS; exact full-control Minecraft fidelity is not promised.
fidelityContract.runtime: Button and Checkbox have independent native references and pixel suites. All other mappings have static evidence only.

observations: The existing bitmap font port covers printable ASCII; full Minecraft font providers are outside that claim.
remainingNativeProbes: Line wrapping, formatting, bidi layout, scaling and shadows need case-specific native captures.

observations: Normal/highlighted border 3; disabled border 1. Original pilot captures exist.
remainingNativeProbes: Non-default shadcn variants and arbitrary content are unverified.

observations: extractContents chooses selected and isFocused sprites; hover alone does not select highlighted sprite.
The class uses getBoxSize(font), label gap 4, and alpha tint. There are four source sprites, not a separate disabled sprite.

Native getBoxSize returns 17 logical pixels although PNGs are 20×20. Exact texel-boundary sampling picks the lower texel; deterministic derivatives preserve the observed nearest samples at scales 1–3.
remainingNativeProbes: Disabled and indeterminate web states require explicit reference decisions; no indeterminate sprite found in widget inventory.

observations: Track and handle are separate sprites with independent metadata.
remainingNativeProbes: Recover handle position/rounding, focus editing mode, min/max and value text. Multi-thumb, vertical and disabled web cases need separate decisions.

observations: Two original text-field sprites are referenced by the class.
remainingNativeProbes: Recover caret timing, selection color/compositing, horizontal scroll, padding and disabled text. Freeze cursor phase.

observations: A native multiline editor and scrollable text-area base exist.
remainingNativeProbes: Determine which border is actually rendered; wrapping, selection, scroll clipping and caret require native captures.

observations: AbstractScrollArea references widget/scroller and widget/scroller_background.
remainingNativeProbes: Recover thumb size/rounding, minimum size, disabled state, clipping and scrolled tile origin.

observations: Four widget/tab state sprites exist.
remainingNativeProbes: Inspect sprite use in navigation bar, selected/focus/hover precedence and selected-tab geometry.

observations: extractTooltipBackground draws separate background and frame. Each starts at content x/y minus 12 and spans content size plus 24.
remainingNativeProbes: Capture actual tooltip content/margins, opacity/compositing and positioning near viewport edges.

observations: PopupScreen references popup/background and draws around its layout with 18 logical pixels on each side.
remainingNativeProbes: Recover layout, title/body baseline, button spacing, background blur/dimming and exact total bounds.

observations: Native screen/dialog classes and input-control handlers exist. Warning buttons have three sprites.
remainingNativeProbes: Screen-sized background is context dependent. Select the actual native layout before using it as a modal reference.

observations: SystemToast references toast/system.
remainingNativeProbes: Freeze entry/exit time; capture multiline sizing, stacking, clipping and alpha.

observations: Separate color backgrounds/progress and notch overlays exist.
remainingNativeProbes: Recover integer fill-width arithmetic, color/style state and overlay order. Vanilla boss-bar dimensions do not prove arbitrary web resizing.

observations: LoadingDotsWidget reads Util.getMillis and calls LoadingDotsText.get(time). It is a dots treatment, not a rotating circle.
remainingNativeProbes: Capture each exact phase using a controlled time source without replacing native rendering.

observations: Player-face rendering classes exist; appearance depends on a skin texture and hat layer.
remainingNativeProbes: Capture the bundled wide Steve face crop with hat on/off at declared sizes; verify fallback and arbitrary supplied skin behavior independently.

observations: Vanilla has specific debug bar/pie charts, not a universal chart system.
remainingNativeProbes: Supply fixed sample data and recover colors, axes, units and scale. Other chart types need designed compositions.

observations: Selection-list classes exist.
remainingNativeProbes: Capture row height, selected/hover outline, truncation, empty list and scroll offsets.

observations: The native command-suggestion class exists.
remainingNativeProbes: Inspect nested suggestion-list renderer; recover row geometry, selected color, completion prefix and placement.

observations: CycleButton.onOffBuilder uses the vanilla on/off labels and boolean options.
remainingNativeProbes: It looks like a button, not a sliding switch. Preserve shadcn role/value behavior while verifying two labeled appearances.

observations: RecipeBookComponent.filterButton is a CycleButton<Boolean>. Its builder uses withSprite and DisplayState.HIDE. StateSwitchingButton is not present in this artifact.
remainingNativeProbes: Inspect the concrete recipe-book subclass getFilterButtonTextures and sprite supplier before choosing generic text/icon toggle layout.

observations: A native item display widget and original container slot sprite exist.
remainingNativeProbes: Pin actual item content and model/resource dependencies, layout and tooltip; arbitrary uploaded file icons are designed extensions.

observations: Book and recipe-book page controls have distinct sprite families.
remainingNativeProbes: Select one reference family; inspect forward/backward hover states and page-count text.

observations: The vanilla chat HUD provides a text/message composition.
remainingNativeProbes: Freeze opacity, message age, fade time, scrolling, wrapped lines and background settings.

observations: Key binding rows use controls that can supply a key-label treatment.
remainingNativeProbes: This is not evidence of a native keycap primitive. Pin key labels/layout and distinguish display-only Kbd semantics.

observations: Book screen exists with original book texture.
remainingNativeProbes: Capture static page background/text; do not stretch a whole book into an arbitrary card.

observations: Vanilla contains menu backgrounds and header/footer separators.
remainingNativeProbes: Choose title-screen or in-world context; check tiling, fade and separators without assuming interchangeable textures.
